<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Reading PostGameFlow, playerRecords, scoreUtils, textUtils, tests, sw.js, normalizeStack, and GameStack tests.

Found a potential bug in GameStack.jsx. Choice matching uses strict equality, but free-text answers use `checkAnswerMatch` which forgives typos.

The strict equality bug could misgrade correct answers if canonical and displayed choices differ. The choice shuffle logic is sound.

The strict equality on choices is intentional. Decoys that match accepted answers variants would be marked wrong, which is acceptable.

getCanonicalAnswer returns the first accepted answer as the canonical answer. The correct choice always matches this canonical value.

The progress save logic is safe because it uses a computed score value rather than the async state.

Resume data does not restore choicesRequested or deeper mode state. This may be intentional.

App.jsx contains a React anti-pattern. It calls setState during render when switching from individual-stacks to solo mode.

Challenge state persists across stack changes but is correctly scoped by stack key.

The daily link parser may run before availableStackKeys are ready.
</details></think>

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Reading additional files: url tests, progressStorage, sw.js, textUtils, normalizeStack, and loadPlayableStacks. Also examining the App.jsx individual-stacks bug more carefully.

Found a bug in PostGameFlow. `mainAnswers` is filtered from `answers` but not re-indexed by question index. Skipped questions leave gaps, so `mainAnswers[i]` returns the wrong answer.

Confirmed the bug is host-only. `handleSkipQuestion` increments depth without pushing an entry to `userAnswers`, so `mainAnswers[i]` returns the next question's answer instead of the skipped one. This misaligns answers when a user skips during solo play.

The fix is to match answers by `questionIndex` instead of array index. This prevents misattributing answers during skips or if question order changes.

Checked `calculateMaxScore` in the finish flow. The `deeper` boolean correctly controls whether deeper bonuses are included in the maximum score.

The `replaceState` call on App mount clears the URL path to prevent duplicate stacks from reopening on refresh. This improves UX but sacrifices shareable bookmarking.

Free choices for kids stacks correctly skip cost penalties.
</details></think>
